## spaceman node create

Register a node and issue its one-time enrollment token.

Registers a node and prints its enrollment token once (or writes it with --secret-file). Start `spaceman-agent enroll` on the node with it before it expires.

```sh
spaceman node create <name> [flags]
```

API: `create-node` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman node create build-01 --label zone=eu --secret-file ./build-01.enroll
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--label` | string, repeatable |  | label (key=value, repeatable) |
| `--secret-file` | string |  | write the one-time secret to this new file (mode 0600) instead of printing it |

## spaceman node disable

Disable a node (no new runs; its lease stays).

```sh
spaceman node disable <node> [flags]
```

API: `set-node-state` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman node enable

Enable a disabled node.

```sh
spaceman node enable <node> [flags]
```

API: `set-node-state` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman node enrollment

Issue a new one-time enrollment token for a pending node.

```sh
spaceman node enrollment <node> [flags]
```

API: `reissue-enrollment` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--secret-file` | string |  | write the one-time secret to this new file (mode 0600) instead of printing it |

## spaceman node revoke

Revoke a node permanently (its credentials stop working).

```sh
spaceman node revoke <node> [flags]
```

API: `set-node-state` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--yes` | bool |  | confirm: revoke the node permanently |

## spaceman node update

Edit a node's name, description and labels (only the flags given change).

```sh
spaceman node update <node> [flags]
```

API: `get-node`, `update-node` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--label` | string, repeatable |  | label (replaces all labels) (key=value, repeatable) |
| `--name` | string |  | new name |
